name: Shinohara Mamiko
source:
A resident of the apartment. A chaste married woman, she is kind and quiet. The mother of the protagonist's classmate, however she looks young enough to be called an older sister.

Her husband works for the government. She knows how to have normal sex since she conceived a child, but is lonely because her husband doesn't care for her.
